lines.en: I swim with my chest-shaped body trailing.
The plates on my belly scrape the rock.
My mouth opens and closes without sound.
Water squeezes past my gills.
I keep low along the seabed.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的纹路在水里晃。
lines.en: The patterns on my shell waver in the water.
Every stroke is slow.
I keep out of the bright water.
My whole boxy body rolls sideways.
A dark current carries me a stretch.
I follow the shadows on the floor.
My gill covers open and close.
I sink along the undercurrent.
I can squeeze through the gap in the reef.
Sand curls up from beneath me.
My plating is heavy.
I hang in the water without moving.
My chest-like shell looks like sunken wood.
I wait for the current to turn.
My gills work slowly.
There is nothing else around.
My armour is hard.
Nothing is clear in the deep water.

lines.zh: 水底的光一层层暗下去。
lines.en: The light on the floor dims layer by layer.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼从我身边掠过。
lines.en: A small fish darts past me.
I right my body.
The seabed is quiet.
Fine sand has settled in the seams of my shell.
I open my mouth, then close it.
There is no prey here.
You have come down.
I square my boxy body at you.
The air in your lungs is running out.
My plates are thicker than yours.
You are holding something.
I am not afraid of you.
Come closer and I will turn around.
I watch your flippers.

lines.zh: 你带的铁器在水里发腥。
lines.en: Your iron gear reeks in the water.
You have backed off a little.
I turn on you at once.
A plate has cracked.
One blow in, one blow back.
The smell of blood spreads.
I shrink back into the reef crack.
The mark on my plate stays.
A dull sound echoes inside my shell.
I right my body.
My armour took some of it.
You really are bold.
I smell blood in the water.
Drop it in the water and I will take it.
That smell gets me moving.
I rise slowly.
The softer the flesh, the better.
Do not pull it away. I am no fast swimmer.
I can bite through this.
I only strike back when struck.
Half a block closer.
The current brings the smell.
My plating slams in, and it is hard.
My whole boxed body shoves you aside.
A dull thud passes through the water.
I drift back a good distance myself.
Sand billows up between us.
My chest shell hits hard.
My shell grazes your leg.
I hold my body steady.
That should have taught you something.
I turn away slowly.
Among seaborn, there is no need for words.
We follow the same dark current.
Plate against plate.
Did you hear the sound from the deep?

lines.zh: 这具身体，会长出新的甲。
lines.en: This body will grow new plates.
Do not rise too near the surface.
We wait beneath the reef.
The same colour.
Let us sink together.
The sea will return us to where we belong.
I take it in my teeth.
I dig up what is buried in the sand.
My teeth will not go into this.
It lodges in my throat.
Whatever lies under the shell is mine.
It drifted out of my mouth.
I crush it slowly.
This one is rather fishy.
I swim a stretch with it in my jaws.
There is no taste at all.
I patrol these reef grounds.
My boxed body turns to you.
My plates have all opened.

lines.zh: 我挨过打，记得怎么回手。
lines.en: I have been hit before, and I remember how to return it.
My gills have swelled.

lines.zh: 你跑不过我，但我也不快。
lines.en: You cannot outrun me. Though I am not fast.
Right here in the reef.
I settle low on the reef.
I brace my plates.
Do not think the water hides you.
I follow your bubbles.

lines.zh: 你往哪儿游，我都看得见。
lines.en: Wherever you swim, I see you.
I am behind the rock.
Each time you surface, I come closer.
My plates scrape along the reef.
I slowly come broadside.
The more you panic, the murkier the water.
The gap between the reef walls narrows.
I can hear your heartbeat.
I wait for you to near the cliff.
I ram with my boxed body sideways.
The edge of my plates slashes across.
You are pinned against the reef.
Threads of blood spread in the water.
I turn and hit again.
That bite went in shallow.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我还你一下。
lines.en: You hit me once, so I hit you once.
I let go and pull back.
A white mark is left on my plate.
Touch me again and see.
The sand on the floor swells.
A chest-like shadow lifts.
I come up from the deep.
A briny smell enters the water.
A faint glow lies on my plates.
I cut through the dark current.

lines.zh: 这具身体，从海里长出来的。
lines.en: This body grew out of the sea.
I worked my way between the rocks.
I open my jaws silently.
No sound, only water.
The surface is burning, so I sink lower.
I hit the reef and my plates clatter.
Outside the water is no place for me.
The shock flips my whole body over.
Something is lodged in a seam of my plates.
This light echoes inside my shell.

lines.zh: 海底的猎物都跑光了，我饿得直叫。
lines.en: Every prey in the sea has fled — I'm starving enough to scream.
Lightning hits the sea and I clench.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我落不下去。
lines.en: There is no water, and I cannot sink.
